title: Open-BEATBox Software: PC application and module firmware
description:
Open-BEATBox (Open - BEhavioural and AuTonomous operant Box) is an open-source, modular, low-cost platform for autonomous home-cage operant conditioning and long-duration behavioural data acquisition in rodents.

This repository holds the PC application that runs the experiments and the MicroPython firmware of the box modules.

Two firmware libraries are Git submodules and are not included in this archive: beatbox-protocol (commit fbb6d08) and ILI9341-parallel-TFT-driver-for-micropython (commit 6c82d2f); see the README to fetch them.

Project website: https://open-beatbox.github.io/. Manual: https://open-beatbox.github.io/docs/manual/.
